checkRuns.command:
sed -i 's/loadBook(params.slug));$/loadBook(params.slug!));/' 'src/routes/books/[slug].tsx' && bun run check 2>&1 | tail -5 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -2
export PORT=4733 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4733 NODE_ENV=production
bun run start >/tmp/s.log 2>&1 & sleep 3
u=http://localhost:4733
curl -s $u/ | grep -o '<main.*</main>' | head -c 700; echo
curl -s $u/books | grep -o '<main.*</main>' | head -c 900; echo
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' $u/books/nope $u/zzz $u/books/dracula
curl -s $u/books/dracula | grep -o '<title>[^<]*\|<main.*</main>' | head -c 1200; echo
curl -s $u/books/nope | grep -o '<title>[^<]*\|aria-current[^>]*'

sed -i 's|<textarea id="message" name="message" value={values()?.message ?? ""} />|<textarea id="message" name="message">{values()?.message ?? ""}</textarea>|' src/routes/contact.tsx
pkill -f ".output/server" ; sleep 1; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -3 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -1
export PORT=4733 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4733 NODE_ENV=production
(bun run start >/tmp/s.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 3
curl -s -X POST -d 'name=&email=&message=short' http://localhost:4733/contact | grep -o '<textarea.*</form>'
pkill -f ".output/server"; sleep 1; ss -ltn | grep 4733

bun run check 2>&1 | tail -3 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -1
export PORT=4733 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4733 NODE_ENV=production
(bun run start >/tmp/s.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 3
curl -s -X POST -d 'name=&email=&message=short' http://localhost:4733/contact | grep -o '<textarea.*</form>'
pkill -f "[.]output/server"; sleep 1; ss -ltn | grep 4733
